name: Patrick Bateman Walking
look: Christian Bale as Patrick Bateman walks toward the camera through a gray office, wearing headphones, a dark suit, white shirt and red tie, with a blank, cold expression. A man in a suit stands blurred in the doorway behind him.
use: Shows walking somewhere with total cold confidence, as if nothing can touch you. The caption names where you're striding in or what you're ignoring, often in the self-serious "sigma" style.
slots: where you're striding in, unbothered (caption above)
examples: Me walking into the office on Monday after ignoring every email all weekend
